The property acquisition establishes the company's uranium exploration asset; exploration results are needed to demonstrate value.
Provides funds for property exploration and working capital, while issuing new shares and warrants.
Each unit includes a $0.10 warrant, valid 2 years
Warrant exercise could provide future capital but would add shares; exercise is above the unit price.
Resumption on the TSXV changes the listing venue; the release gives no trading-liquidity or valuation impact.
This is an early-stage asset and financing update, with no exploration results disclosed. The next catalyst would be exploration work on the property and disclosure of results.
